approaches.title: Enumerate calendar days
approaches.summary: Parse dates into month/day pairs, then visit each day of the year and count those contained in both date ranges.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Checks every calendar day against both inclusive date ranges and counts the overlap.

approaches.title: Convert dates to day numbers
approaches.summary: Map each date to its day number in the year, intersect the two inclusive ranges, and compute the overlap length.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces day-by-day enumeration with day-number conversion and a direct interval intersection.

revisions.commitBody:
- move prefix calculation to compile time
- borrowing date strings instead of moving ownership
- direct parsing of date string with byte arithmetic
- replace result if statement with branchless .max (if-conversion
already did this, so this is just explicitly making it branchless)
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the interval-intersection strategy while computing month prefixes at compile time and parsing date bytes directly.
